correctness.rationale: The cycle selects at most one member of each of 120 nonpalindromic length-eight reversal pairs. Its balanced directed de Bruijn incidence forces selected signed ports to pair positively/negatively in each of 72 reversal orbits; matching omitted pair ports through cost-one edges yields a perfect matching on 240 ports. The independently rebuilt graph has 120 cost-one omission plus 210 cost-zero transition edges. The actual pinned DUAL.txt 240 integers sum to 28 and satisfy y_u+y_v<=cost for every one of 330 edges, proving at least 28 omitted reversal pairs and hence length<=92 without trusting solver output. The pinned WITNESS.txt has exactly 92 cyclic distinct nonpalindromic length-eight factors, no reversal collisions and fundamental period92. A separate independent script reconstructed graph, all inequalities, port-count and witness tests from source bytes. No exhaustive search or computational timeout is invoked as impossibility.
residual_risks: Order eight binary cyclic words; linear words, larger orders and nonbinary alphabets not covered.
